versions.changelog: v1.3.1: 优化报告生成性能、增加超时时间到 600 秒、完善中国模型监控（GLM/Qwen/Kimi/MiniMax/Step/DeepSeek 等）、优化定时任务配置

v1.3.0: 新增中国模型监控 - 新增智谱 GLM、阿里 Qwen、月之暗面 Kimi、MiniMax、阶跃星辰 Step、DeepSeek、百川、01.AI 等中国大模型公司追踪、新增 OpenCompass/C-Eval 等中文基准排行榜监控、新增中国 AI 初创公司融资动态、Company Strategy Watch 新增 Alibaba Qwen 和 Zhipu AI 专栏、GitHub Trending 增加中国仓库监控、Model Reranking 支持中国模型进入 Top 10 榜单

v1.2.0: 重大策略更新 - 新增时间窗口分析 (1w/1m/3m)、新增 Model Reranking Watch (Top 10 排行榜)、新增 Claude Agent Watch (managed agents/agent teams/enterprise controls)、新增 Company Strategy Watch (OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/Microsoft)、新增 GitHub Trending Watch、强化连续性规则 (刷新/delta/标签)、强化深度要求 (What/Why/Evidence/Action)、新增 Anthropic/Claude Agent 信号追踪
v1.1.1: 统一输出路径前缀为 memory/research/tech-trend-radar-*，支持按周期 (WXX/1m/3m) 和主题 (ai-agents 等) 分类存储报告
v1.1.0: 新增 AI Model Ranking 信息追踪功能，支持 LMArena、Artificial Analysis、LiveBench、SWE-bench、OpenRouter 等多个排行榜；新增 GitHub Trending 信号追踪；新增时间窗口 (1w/1m/3m) 分析支持

Initial release of tech-trend-radar

- Generates up-to-date technology and market trend reports across AI, SaaS, developer tools, cloud, security, startups, funding, and regulation.
- Prioritizes signals based on source quality, GitHub momentum, business impact, and actionability.
- Supports multiple reporting periods (1w/1m/3m) and compares short-term and durable trends.
- Includes reproducible research workflow, clear report format, and scoring criteria for industry signals.
- Monitors GitHub Trending and major categories for actionable insights and early trend detection.
